limits: The added weather cases specify wind and stability class; they are not a radiation-resolving daytime model.
Three transient situations each integrate for 30 seconds; hourly fixture labels do not represent three hours of physical integration.
Output differences quantify numerical storage changes; there is no independent true atmospheric concentration reference.
Single-worker fixed-seed repeatability applies to these controlled cases only.
Cases balance cost and coverage; they are not a full factorial design and do not isolate individual meteorology, resolution or particle-budget effects.
No production-domain throughput or total peak-memory claim.
